name: Apply transformations to tract masks
summary: Applies an existing ANTs or FSL transform (affine plus optional nonlinear warp) to every mask in a tract-mask set with ANTs antsApplyTransforms, resampling them onto a chosen reference image.
description: Wraps antsApplyTransforms to move each NIfTI tract mask into another space using a precomputed transform (warp, inverse warp and affine). The reference grid is the first optional fixed input provided, in the order T1w, T2w, parcellation, mask, DWI, FA; at least one must be given. FLIRT/FNIRT transforms can be converted to ITK format first (fsl_transform). Use NearestNeighbor interpolation to keep masks binary. It does not estimate a registration.

inputs.description: Precomputed transform: nonlinear warp, inverse warp and affine matrix (ANTs format, or FSL FLIRT/FNIRT when fsl_transform is set).
inputs.requirements: The warp matching the chosen direction must be present unless affine_only is set.

inputs.description: Folder of tract masks (NIfTI); each mask is transformed.
Optional T1w image used as the reference grid (first choice).
Optional T2w image used as the reference grid if no T1w reference is given.
Optional parcellation used as the reference grid if no T1w/T2w reference is given.
Optional mask used as the reference grid if no earlier reference is given.
Optional DWI used as the reference grid if no earlier reference is given.
Optional tensor maps; the FA map is used as the reference grid if no earlier reference is given.

outputs.description: The tract masks resampled into the reference space, one NIfTI per input mask.

parameters.description: If true, converts affine and warp to from FSL to ANTs-compatible format

failure_modes.message: Error: No valid anatomical reference found in config.json
failure_modes.cause: None of the optional fixed (reference) inputs was provided.
failure_modes.fix: Provide at least one reference image.

failure_modes.message: Error: affine_only is false but appropriate warp is missing
failure_modes.cause: The transform lacks the warp (or inverse warp when inverse is set).
failure_modes.fix: Provide a transform with the needed warp or set affine_only.
